newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sharjah's first quarter 1997 non-oil trade stood at 2.6 billion dirhams, up 2.88 percent in tonnage terms and 0.44 percent in value terms over the same period a year earlier.
- Bahrain Duty Free is to be floated in September, unnamed sources said.
- Total assets of the UAE's central bank increased during the first quarter of 1997 by eight percent to 31.68 billion dirhams, the bank announced on Saturday.

- The Abu Dhabi Public Works Department has started preparations to build the Taweelah Industrial Port, a project which will cost some two billion dirhams and is expected to come into operation in 2000.
- The Abu Dhabi Public Works Department is planning to construct a port in Mussafah for which a tender will be called soon.
- A $33 million earth station for international telecommunications will be constructed between Jebel Ali and Hatta in the UAE, an official source at telecommunications company Etisalat said.
- Qatar's emir said his country was still committed to holding the Middle East and North Africa economic summit in Doha in November.
- Dubai's cargo village handled 8.5 percent more cargo in the first quarter of this year than in the year-ago period, a report from the cargo village said.
